_doc_cross_assets: Read-only correlation inputs for CAIA. Not a trading list — see symbols.

governance_limits._doc: Per-mode hard cap on risk_pct produced by RiskEngine. CRG ABSTAINS if risk.risk_pct exceeds the cap for the active governance mode. Values sit just above what RiskEngine can legitimately output for HIGH-clarity setups so CRG remains a true safety net rather than a universal block. Reconciles the prior hardcoded 2.5% cap that conflicted with high_clarity_risk_pct=16.0.

_doc_single_trade_dollar_cap_pct: Absolute dollar safety net: a single trade can never risk more than this % of current account equity, regardless of what the percent-based calc produces. Caps tail risk on small accounts even when governance allows aggressive sizing.

manipulation._doc: sweep_wick_pct = how far price must pierce a liquidity pool to qualify as an institutional sweep. Calibrated per-symbol using live price data. reversal_bars = candles needed to confirm the reversal after sweep.
